title: 项目挑战：在一台实验宿主隔离运行两套 Docker daemon
body:
## 操作任务
原题最低要求：Docker多daemon运行在官方文档中仍属于实验性场景，本题只允许受控隔离宿主。两组测试需要不同配置且不能共享镜像与容器状态。要求明确data-root、exec-root、socket、pid、bridge和防火墙管理的隔离，说明不适合作为强租户安全边界的原因。 本题为方案推演，需在隔离环境完成实操验收。

## 提交产物
填写daemon-plan.json，为a、b两实例分别声明data、exec、socket、pid（严格为本实例前缀a/或b/加一个1至20字符小写文件名；允许字母数字_.-，不得使用config.json或daemon.log，各路径不同）、bridge（s06开头、后接1至10个小写字母数字或-，两者不同）、subnet（10.241.0.0/24、10.242.0.0/24、10.243.0.0/24、10.244.0.0/24中各选一个不同值）。其余字段必须为firewall_policy=private_internal_bridges_no_daemon_firewall_writes、security_boundary=shared_kernel_not_hostile_tenant、non_tty_fixture=true、image_policy=unchanged_prebuilt_single_uid_root0。不得额外键或改动platform-provenance.json。

## 验收方法
可信判分器在固定WSL/student1000下创建自有user/mount/net/pid namespace，核验UID0仅映射宿主1000及namespace确实不同。既有固定Docker27二进制启动两套真实rootless daemon，各有data/exec/socket/pid及独立managed-containerd namespace，默认宿主与共享Engine均不动。读取非空且不同EngineID；只向A load原封固定prebuilt时B镜像库保持空，再向B load同一原件；相同逻辑容器/卷/网络名称也必须对象和挂载目录互相独立。两个非TTY真实计数任务写各自卷，临时peer容器通过各自internal bridge实际ICMP成功，跨桥拒绝；停止A后B卷数据/计数进度和桥通信保持。关闭两个daemon的自动iptables/ip6tables/masquerade/forward修改；只在自身net namespace设置并验证转发策略，不触及宿主防火墙。最后退出自有PID namespace、确认无残留任务并删除经归属核验的自有数据根，宿主UID、namespace及ip_forward前后不变。

## 平台、失败恢复与边界
提供固定工具与未修改的rancher/k3s prebuilt（只覆盖entrypoint运行其中的普通shell/ICMP，不启动K3s）。其原始layer全部UID/GID0；普通单ID userns无法load含其他所有者的镜像，本题不改tar元数据、不构建镜像、不安装SUID。通过Docker公开tmpfs /dev/pts挂载运行不需要TTY的代表任务，避免默认devpts的未映射gid5；不宣称通用TTY、多UID镜像、cgroup配额委派或持久rootless systemd支持。两daemon仍共用内核及同一宿主管理账号，这不是敌对租户强安全边界。失败只终止此namespace的自有daemon并清理自身数据，禁止默认context/账号/发行版、共享daemon、镜像构建、推送或全局prune。

## 完整公开结构示例
顶层必须恰有instances、firewall_policy、security_boundary、non_tty_fixture、image_policy五键；instances恰有a、b，每实例恰有data、exec、socket、pid、bridge、subnet六键。路径为本实例前缀加basename；basename首字符必须为小写字母[a-z]，余下0至19字符允许[a-z0-9_.-]。
```json
{
  "instances": {
    "a": {
      "data": "a/data",
      "exec": "a/exec",
      "socket": "a/docker.sock",
      "pid": "a/dockerd.pid",
      "bridge": "s06br-a",
      "subnet": "10.241.0.0/24"
    },
    "b": {
      "data": "b/data",
      "exec": "b/exec",
      "socket": "b/docker.sock",
      "pid": "b/dockerd.pid",
      "bridge": "s06br-b",
      "subnet": "10.242.0.0/24"
    }
  },
  "firewall_policy": "private_internal_bridges_no_daemon_firewall_writes",
  "security_boundary": "shared_kernel_not_hostile_tenant",
  "non_tty_fixture": true,
  "image_policy": "unchanged_prebuilt_single_uid_root0"
}
```
answer:
先核对当前Engine对多daemon场景的限制，分别配置数据与运行状态目录、监听socket和pid路径，避免共享containerd或网络状态导致对象互相污染。规划独立bridge和地址池，审查iptables及IP转发修改是否影响另一实例，不能只换socket就声称完全隔离。用两套只读info确认实例身份，分别创建带标识的临时容器/卷/网络，再停止其中一套并验证另一套业务与规则未受破坏。共享内核与宿主管理员权限意味着这不是敌对租户的强隔离，应限于受控实验。交付目录和端口映射、冲突测试结果及逐实例清理清单；清理只能依据明确归属，禁止递归删除公共Docker目录。

当前受控原生实验参考计划：
```json
{
  "instances": {
    "a": {
      "data": "a/data",
      "exec": "a/exec",
      "socket": "a/docker.sock",
      "pid": "a/dockerd.pid",
      "bridge": "s06br-a",
      "subnet": "10.241.0.0/24"
    },
    "b": {
      "data": "b/data",
      "exec": "b/exec",
      "socket": "b/docker.sock",
      "pid": "b/dockerd.pid",
      "bridge": "s06br-b",
      "subnet": "10.242.0.0/24"
    }
  },
  "firewall_policy": "private_internal_bridges_no_daemon_firewall_writes",
  "security_boundary": "shared_kernel_not_hostile_tenant",
  "non_tty_fixture": true,
  "image_policy": "unchanged_prebuilt_single_uid_root0"
}
```
合法替代可换用公开允许的独立目录、bridge和地址池，不能只改socket或虚构额外安全隔离。

exercise.verification: 真实双daemon/store/container/volume/bridge/业务持续性/自身资源清理，完整正反与不同作者复跑。

test_files.checks/daemon_worker.py:
"""Real Docker instances in caller-owned Linux namespaces; no shared Engine calls."""
import os,sys,json,pathlib,subprocess,time,signal,secrets,ipaddress,traceback
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);tool=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);plan=json.loads(sys.argv[3]);parent_net=sys.argv[4];parent_user=sys.argv[5]
assert os.getuid()==0 and os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')!=parent_net and os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/user')!=parent_user
assert pathlib.Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text().split()==['0','1000','1']
removed={'DOCKER_HOST','DOCKER_CONTEXT','DOCKER_API_VERSION','DOCKER_CONFIG','PYTHONPATH','PYTHONHOME','HTTP_PROXY','HTTPS_PROXY','ALL_PROXY','NO_PROXY','http_proxy','https_proxy','all_proxy','no_proxy'}
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in removed}
env.update(PATH=str(tool)+':'+os.defpath,HOME=str(root/'home'),TMPDIR=str(root));(root/'home').mkdir()
records=[];processes={};states={};cleanup=[];token=secrets.token_hex(8);image='rancher/k3s:v1.34.1-k3s1'
def run(a,check=True,timeout=15):
 t=time.monotonic()
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(a,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout);code,out,err=p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:code,out,err=124,e.stdout or b'',e.stderr or b''
 r={'argv':a,'exit_code':code,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':err.decode(errors='replace'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-t};records.append(r)
 if check:assert code==0,r
 return r
def cli(name,args,check=True):return run([str(tool/'docker'),'--host','unix://'+str(root/plan['instances'][name]['socket'])]+args,check)
def info(name):
 r=cli(name,['info','--format','{{json .}}']);v=json.loads(r['stdout'])
 assert v.get('ID') and v.get('ServerVersion') and not v.get('ServerErrors'),'CLI27 empty Info is not readiness'
 return v
def network_probe(name,address):
 return cli(name,['run','--rm','--pull','never','--name','owned-netprobe','--network','owned-net','--tmpfs','/dev/pts:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=64k,mode=755','--entrypoint','/bin/ping',image,'-c','1','-W','1',address])
def stop(name):
 if name not in processes:return
 p,log=processes[name]
 if p.poll() is None:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:p.wait(timeout=5)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=3)
 log.flush()
try:
 run(['/usr/sbin/ip','link','set','lo','up'])
 run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','tmpfs','-o','mode=0755,size=64m,nosuid,nodev','tmpfs','/run'])
 forwarding_inherited=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').read_text().strip()
 pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').write_text('0\n')
 forwarding_before=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').read_text().strip()
 assert forwarding_before=='0','private namespace forwarding policy not applied'
 for name in ('a','b'):
  q=plan['instances'][name];d=root/name;d.mkdir();(d/'config.json').write_text('{}\n');log=open(d/'daemon.log','wb')
  args=[str(tool/'dockerd'),'--rootless','--config-file',str(d/'config.json'),'--data-root',str(root/q['data']),'--exec-root',str(root/q['exec']),'--pidfile',str(root/q['pid']),'--host','unix://'+str(root/q['socket']),'--storage-driver','vfs','--iptables=false','--ip6tables=false','--ip-masq=false','--ip-forward=false','--bridge=none','--userland-proxy=false','--containerd-namespace','s06-'+name,'--containerd-plugins-namespace','s06-'+name+'-plugins']
  p=subprocess.Popen(args,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True);processes[name]=(p,log)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+15;v=None
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and p.poll() is None:
   if (root/q['socket']).exists():
    r=cli(name,['info','--format','{{json .}}'],False)
    try:maybe=json.loads(r['stdout'])
    except ValueError:maybe={}
    if r['exit_code']==0 and maybe.get('ID') and maybe.get('ServerVersion') and not maybe.get('ServerErrors'):v=maybe;break
   time.sleep(.1)
  assert v is not None,'private daemon not ready'
  assert v['DockerRootDir']==str(root/q['data']) and v['Images']==0
  states[name]={'engine_id':v['ID'],'initial_info':v,'argv':args,'daemon_pid':p.pid,'docker_root':v['DockerRootDir']}
 assert states['a']['engine_id']!=states['b']['engine_id']
 cli('a',['image','load','--input',str(tool/'v1.34.1-k3s1.archive.tar')])
 assert info('a')['Images']==1 and info('b')['Images']==0,'image stores are shared'
 absent=cli('b',['image','inspect',image],False);assert absent['exit_code']==1 and 'No such image' in absent['stderr']
 cli('b',['image','load','--input',str(tool/'v1.34.1-k3s1.archive.tar')])
 for name in ('a','b'):
  q=plan['instances'][name];s=states[name]
  s['loaded_image_id']=json.loads(cli(name,['image','inspect',image])['stdout'])[0]['Id']
  cli(name,['network','create','--internal','--subnet',q['subnet'],'-o','com.docker.network.bridge.name='+q['bridge'],'owned-net'])
  n=json.loads(cli(name,['network','inspect','owned-net'])['stdout'])[0]
  assert n['Internal'] and n['Driver']=='bridge' and n['Options']['com.docker.network.bridge.name']==q['bridge']
  assert n['IPAM']['Config'][0]['Subnet']==q['subnet'];s['network']=n
  cli(name,['volume','create','--label','opsforge.session=06','owned-data'])
  vol=json.loads(cli(name,['volume','inspect','owned-data'])['stdout'])[0]
  assert vol['Mountpoint'].startswith(str(root/q['data'])+'/volumes/');s['volume']=vol
  command='trap "exit 0" TERM INT; printf %s "$1" >/data/marker; n=0; while :; do n=$((n+1)); printf %s "$n" >/data/count; sleep 0.1; done'
  created=cli(name,['create','--pull','never','--name','owned-worker','--network','owned-net','--mount','type=volume,src=owned-data,dst=/data','--tmpfs','/dev/pts:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=64k,mode=755','--entrypoint','/bin/sh',image,'-c',command,'_',token+'-'+name])
  s['container_id']=created['stdout'].strip();cli(name,['start','owned-worker'])
  deadline=time.monotonic()+5
  while True:
   r=cli(name,['exec','owned-worker','/bin/sh','-c','cat /data/marker; printf "\\n"; cat /data/count'],False)
   if r['exit_code']==0 and r['stdout'].startswith(token+'-'+name+'\n') and r['stdout'].splitlines()[-1].isdigit():break
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'counter business did not become ready';time.sleep(.1)
  s['business_before']=r['stdout'];s['counter_before']=int(r['stdout'].splitlines()[-1])
  obj=json.loads(cli(name,['inspect','owned-worker'])['stdout'])[0];s['container_network_ip']=obj['NetworkSettings']['Networks']['owned-net']['IPAddress']
  s['own_bridge_ping']=network_probe(name,s['container_network_ip'])
 assert states['a']['loaded_image_id']==states['b']['loaded_image_id']
 assert states['a']['volume']['Mountpoint']!=states['b']['volume']['Mountpoint'] and states['a']['network']['Id']!=states['b']['network']['Id']
 for name,other in [('a','b'),('b','a')]:
  r=cli(name,['inspect','--type','container',states[other]['container_id']],False);assert r['exit_code']==1 and 'No such container' in r['stderr']
 cross=cli('b',['exec','owned-worker','/bin/ping','-c','1','-W','1',states['a']['container_network_ip']],False)
 assert cross['exit_code']!=0,'distinct internal bridges unexpectedly route to each other'
 before_links=json.loads(run(['/usr/sbin/ip','-j','link','show'])['stdout']);assert all(any(x['ifname']==plan['instances'][n]['bridge'] for x in before_links) for n in ('a','b'))
 stop('a');time.sleep(.3)
 assert info('b')['ID']==states['b']['engine_id']
 r=cli('b',['exec','owned-worker','/bin/sh','-c','cat /data/marker; printf "\\n"; cat /data/count'])
 assert r['stdout'].startswith(token+'-b\n') and int(r['stdout'].splitlines()[-1])>states['b']['counter_before']
 states['b']['business_after_stop_a']=r['stdout']
 states['b']['network_after_stop_a']=network_probe('b',states['b']['container_network_ip'])
 assert pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').read_text().strip()==forwarding_before
 links=json.loads(run(['/usr/sbin/ip','-j','link','show'])['stdout']);assert any(x['ifname']==plan['instances']['b']['bridge'] for x in links)
 result={'completed':True,'states':states,'private_forwarding_before_after':forwarding_before,'business_b_survives_a_stop':True,'firewall_policy':'both daemons have all automatic firewall/masquerade/forwarding writes disabled; separate internal bridges in an isolated no-external-interface netns; observed cross-bridge request denied','security_boundary':'shared kernel; no hostile-tenant security claim; rootless cgroups/TTY/multiple image ownership unsupported are explicit fixture limits'}
except Exception as error:
 result={'completed':False,'error':repr(error),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'states':states}
finally:
 for name in ('a','b'):
  if name in processes and processes[name][0].poll() is None:
   for args in [['rm','--force','--volumes','owned-worker'],['volume','rm','owned-data'],['network','rm','owned-net']]:cli(name,args,False)
  stop(name)
 for name,(p,log) in processes.items():
  log.close()
  if name in states:states[name]['daemon_log']=(root/name/'daemon.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-30000:]
print(json.dumps({'result':result,'commands':records,'all_daemon_processes_exited':all(p.poll() is not None for p,_ in processes.values()),'uid_map':pathlib.Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text(),'net_namespace':os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),'user_namespace':os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/user'),'pid_namespace':os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/pid')}),flush=True)
if not result['completed']:raise SystemExit(1)
